title: The Poultry Keeper's Son
summary: The boy who tended the geese in the village common spent his evenings carving intricate figures of animals from discarded willow twigs....
full_text:
The boy who tended the geese in the village common spent his evenings carving intricate figures of animals from discarded willow twigs.

A visiting patron saw the genius in his work and took him to the royal capital. The boy worked tirelessly, mastered the sculptor's art, and created the magnificent statues that adorned the national parliament, never forgetting the honest birds that had inspired his first strokes.
moral: A humble origin is no barrier to excellence when diligence and honesty guide one's steps.
